```lean
theorem lg_target (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h2 : p ≠ 2) : Odd p := by
  have h3 : ¬(2 ∣ p) := by
    rintro (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 * k = p)
    rw [hk] at hp
    exact hp (by rfl)
  have h4 : p % 2 = 1 := by
    rcases h3 with ⟨⟩
    constructor
    exact le_div_of_mul_eq hk
    exact Nat.mod_eq_iff_div_eq.mp (Nat.div_eq_of_le hk)
  exact Odd.mk h4
```
